app.title: Home
app.tagline: Your devices, automations and activity — view only, end-to-end encrypted.

devices.viewOnly: Viewing only: devices show their state as it last synced. To control devices or add new ones, use Home on your Android phone or your computer.
devices.emptyBody: Devices appear here once a Tenshu Hub in your realm reports them. Adding devices on the web isn’t available.

automations.emptyBody: Automations you create in Home on Android or desktop appear here. Editing on the web isn’t available.

activity.empty: Nothing here yet — automation runs will show up in this feed.
activity.emptyDevices: Device events aren’t recorded yet, so nothing from your devices appears here.
activity.emptyVoice: Voice isn’t available yet, so nothing from Mia appears here.

outcome.missed: Missed — the device was not awake

errors.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.error_unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.error_internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.error_invalid_caller: This app is not allowed to do that.
errors.error_unannounced_session: Tenshu needs to reconnect. Please try again.
errors.error_unsupported_operation: This version does not support that yet.
errors.error_home_bad_cursor: Activity lost its place. Reload it to start from the top.
errors.error_home_bad_page_size: Activity couldn’t be read in pages of that size.
errors.error_home_service_unavailable: Home’s data can’t be reached in this browser right now.
errors.error_home_stream_ended: The connection to Home’s data ended.
errors.bridge: Couldn’t reach Tenshu. Make sure it is open and unlocked, then try again.
errors.bridge_timeout: Tenshu took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.bridge_not_permitted: Home is not allowed to do that.

stream.stopped: Updates stopped — what you see may be out of date.

runtime.connectingBody: The Tenshu tab hosting Home is busy. Home will load as soon as it answers.
runtime.elsewhereTitle: Tenshu is open in another tab
runtime.elsewhereBody: Tenshu runs in one tab at a time, so your data can't get out of step. Use it here to move it to this tab.
runtime.moving: Waiting for the other tab to finish saving. This can take up to two minutes.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: This part of Home hit an unexpected error. Your data is safe — nothing was changed.
